## Welcome

This course provides hands-on training in the simulation, operation, and optimization of thermal power plants using industry-standard simulation software.

**Instructor:** Serhat Beyenir  
**Schedule:** 4 periods per week (September – December 2026)  
**Format:** Lectures + Simulations

### Course Highlights

- Dynamic simulation of Rankine and combined cycles
- Plant performance analysis and optimization
- Fault detection and troubleshooting scenarios
- Efficiency and environmental impact assessment

::: {.callout-important}
**First Class:** September 8, 2026
:::
